instruction: Walk to the other end of the lobby and wait near the exit.

steps.thought: I see a large lobby with a kitchen/bar ahead and an illuminated EXIT sign on the right wall. The goal is the far end near that exit, so I will turn right toward it and then advance while re-checking alignment.

I'm in a large lobby with a bar on the left and a blue mural wall on the right. The far end of the lobby appears to have a doorway with a green exit sign, so I'll advance toward it while staying in the open floor area.
I'm in a large lobby with a bar area on the left and a doorway with a green exit sign at the far end. I need to walk toward that far end near the exit door, advancing carefully and re-observing.
I'm progressing through the lobby toward the doorway with the green exit sign visible ahead. The exit is still several meters away, so I'll continue advancing toward it.

I'm in the lobby facing down its length toward a door with a green EXIT sign, which is the exit the instruction refers to. It looks a few meters ahead, so I'll advance along the clear corridor and re-observe before getting close.
I have traversed the lobby and now face a door with an EXIT sign directly ahead, a few meters away. I'll advance a couple of steps toward it, then stop near the exit.
I have walked down the lobby corridor and the exit door with the green EXIT sign is directly ahead, roughly 3 m away. I'll take one more careful forward step to get near the exit, then stop.
